title: LucidDream
tagline: The Journal that forever lives, securely decentralised, easy to use

prizes.title: Build Data Economies & Tools Together with Filecoin

description: Lucidly is a decentralised way to document your life in a secure way that lives forever on the Blockchain, our memories our experiences our lives are what makes us human and what if in three or four generations time my grandchildren want to know more about me, their ancestors :)
how_its_made: The objective of this initiative over the weekend is to build the minimal lovable product, and that is, the ability to upload journal entries over IPFS via the FileCoin network, using Lighthouse tooling. The user journey starts by logining via their wallet using metamask. When the user decides to append an entry to their journal, the dapp will first retrieve a key via their wallet to enable AES encryption of their text, which is then followed by a simple to click upload process to the FileCoin network, the dapp is built using react and node
